answer_1.quote: Modern language models can now generate text as fluently as humans in response to any given sequence or instruction.
answer_1.outputs: controlled text continuations with target attributes such as category and sentiment

answer_2.quote: In the category controlled generation task, we employ Perplexity (PPL) calculated from LLaMA2-13B as the metric for measuring fluency. For assessing controllability, we employ the MAUVE metric.

answer_3.quote: Recently, it has become increasingly recognized that using GPT-4 to assess the quality of text correlates more closely with human preferences compared to existing evaluation metrics.
